hypothesis: A muscular approachable guide may increase voluntary viewing compared with the same less-muscular guide; the direction and downstream confidence effects remain uncertain.

arms.R: Same identity, less muscular definition; similarity is measured, not assumed

eligibility: Self-identified men aged 18-35, at most six months consistent resistance training; pretest participants excluded from main screen.
assignment: Within each age band, three shuffled complete blocks of all six arm/topic combinations, allocated in enrollment order after eligibility.
primary_metric: Played at least 90% of unique media time while visible on first exposure; exclude replay and background time.
missingness: Preserve all assignments, starts, skips, dropouts, technical failures and reasons. Technical failures are missing, not zero; separately report conservative all-assigned completion sensitivity.
pilot_selection: Feasibility and directional evidence only; no reliable retention winner. Advance only with functioning manipulation, at least 10/12 comprehension passes and no recurring unresolved material misunderstanding. Inspect two independent character-related discouragement reports. Consider G and measured production cost.

confirmation_example.method: Standard two-proportion normal approximation, rounded up; large-effect planning scenario, not forecast. Freeze final design before enrollment.

citation_followup.primary_item: I would trust this channel to explain another beginner question.
citation_followup.controls: Same character, narration, scope, captions and runtime; fresh balanced first exposure. Never remove accessible source links.
citation_followup.interpretation: Exploratory usability/trust screen, not powered for small citation effects. Separate from CT1.
